integrity: A universal proof from trace quadratic forms and Frobenius-semilinear solution-space dimension; finite exact checks are supplementary, not an infinite certificate.
scientific_limitations: Necessary, not sufficient maximality conditions. Sparse binomials in odd characteristic; no existence classification; full priority against general quadratic-form algorithms unresolved.
title: A fixed-field degree obstruction to extremality in binomial Artin–Schreier families
